entries.title: Making mac and cheese with dad
entries.body: I helped dad make mac and cheese. I poured the noodles in the pot and dad said watch out it is hot. And then I stirred the cheese and it got all stretchy. Some cheese fell on the floor. Lucas tried to eat it off the floor and dad said no no no. Dad let the top get crunchy in the oven. That is the best part. I ate two bowls, maybe like a hundred noodles.
entries.highlight: Helped dad make mac and cheese for dinner and was proud he stirred it himself.

entries.title: Library trip after school
entries.body: Mom picked me up from school and it was just me and her. She let me pick the music in the car. I picked the shark song two times. And then we went to the library. I got a book about whales and a funny comic book about a pig. Mom read me the whale one at bedtime. Did you know a blue whale is longer than a bus? I want to see one but not in deep water.
entries.favorite: Picking the music in the car
entries.highlight: Went to the library with mom after school and picked out an ocean picture book.

entries.title: Freeze tag with Noah until dark
entries.body: Me and Noah played freeze tag at the park. I was the freezer and I froze Noah like ten times. And then more kids came and said can we play? So we had a big game with like a hundred kids. Okay maybe eight. Noah is really fast but I tagged him behind the slide. We played until it got dark and dad said two more minutes. It was the best day ever.
entries.highlight: Played freeze tag with Noah at the park until dark, and other kids joined in.

entries.title: Thanksgiving at grandma's
entries.body: We drove to grandma's house today because tomorrow is Thanksgiving. The car ride was so long and Lucas fell asleep with a cracker in his hand. Grandma already made two pumpkin pies and the whole house smelled like pie. At dinner we practiced what we are thankful for. I said my family and pie. Everybody laughed but I meant it. Then grandma told me her pie rule for tomorrow. You have to eat one green bean first. One green bean! I can do that. I am sleeping in the room with the big quilt.
entries.highlight: Drove to grandma's the night before Thanksgiving, practiced saying what he was thankful for, and learned grandma's pie rule.

entries.title: So many gummy worms
entries.body: I ate gummy worms. And then more gummy worms. And then more gummy worms. The red and blue ones are the best ones. I made one wiggle like a real worm and Lucas screamed and then he laughed. I gave Lucas three. He only ate two and put one in his hair. Mom said that is enough worms for one day. I had no tummy ache. Not even a little.
entries.favorite: The red and blue gummy worms
entries.highlight: Ate a big bag of gummy worms, shared some with Lucas, and had no tummy ache.

entries.title: Shark Bite in the cold
entries.body: We went to the ice cream shop even though it is cold outside. Mom said that is silly but okay. I got Shark Bite. It is blue like the ocean and it has little gummy sharks in it. I counted the gummy sharks and there were nineteen. Lucas got vanilla and it got all over his coat. The man at the shop gave me a sticker of an ice cream cone. I put it on my water bottle.
entries.favorite: Shark Bite with the gummy sharks
entries.highlight: Got Shark Bite ice cream with mom even though it was cold outside.

entries.title: Pizza night with flour everywhere
entries.body: Me and dad made pizza for dinner. We squished the dough with our hands. It was sticky and cold. I got flour on my shirt and on my nose and dad said I look like a ghost. I put the pepperoni on like a smiley face. Lucas only wanted cheese so he got a cheese corner. It was a little messy but it was so good. Dad said I am his pizza helper now.
entries.favorite: Making a smiley face with pepperoni
entries.highlight: Made homemade pizza with dad and decorated his slice with a pepperoni face.

entries.title: Waffles before school
entries.body: This morning dad made waffles before school. He cut mine in the shape of a shark. It kind of looked like a potato but I knew it was a shark. I put syrup in all the little squares like tiny swimming pools. Lucas had little tiny waffle sticks. I ate so fast I almost missed the bus. I did not miss the bus. I told Theo about the shark waffle and he wants one too.
entries.favorite: The waffle shaped like a shark
entries.highlight: Had waffles before school, including one dad cut into the shape of a shark.

entries.title: My puppy would be named Waffles
entries.body: I asked mom for a puppy again. She said we will see. We will see is not a yes and it is not a no. If I get a puppy I am going to name him Waffles. Because waffles are fluffy and puppies are fluffy. I would feed him and walk him and he could sleep on my bed. Lucas said he wants to name it Truck. No. It is Waffles.
entries.highlight: Asked mom for a puppy again and decided the puppy would be named Waffles.

entries.title: Theo slept over in our submarine
entries.body: Theo came over and we built a submarine out of every blanket and all the couch pillows. And then Theo's mom said he could sleep over. The first time a friend ever slept over at my house! We had flashlights in the submarine and told scary stories but not too scary. Lucas tried to come in and I said this is a big boy submarine. Then I let him in for one minute. We fell asleep in the submarine. It was the best day ever.
entries.favorite: Sleeping in the submarine with a flashlight
entries.highlight: Had a friend sleep over for the first time, with Theo in a blanket submarine they built in the living room.

entries.title: Counting dogs at the park
entries.body: There were so many dogs at the park today. I counted seven. One dog was wearing little boots on all his feet. He walked funny like he was on ice. A fluffy white dog let me pet him and he licked my glove. His owner said he is very friendly. I told her I am getting a puppy named Waffles someday. She said that is a great name.
entries.highlight: Counted the dogs at the park after school and pet a fluffy white one.

entries.title: Red light green light at recess
entries.body: At recess we played red light green light. Theo was the stoplight. I was the best at freezing. I froze like a statue even when my nose itched. Not like a shark. Did you know some sharks have to keep swimming even when they rest? And then Sofia wiggled and she had to go back. I won one time! When we came inside Ms. Rivera said our cheeks were so red. We had a math worksheet about counting by tens. I like counting by tens.
entries.highlight: Played red light green light at recess and won one round by freezing perfectly.

entries.title: Hot chocolate and Christmas lights
entries.body: It was cold so we had hot chocolate on the porch with blankets. I had the tiny marshmallows. I put like a hundred in my cup. And then we looked at the lights on our street. The house across the street has a blow up snowman that is taller than dad. Lucas waved at it. He thinks it is real. I burned my tongue a tiny bit but I was okay.
entries.highlight: Drank hot chocolate on the porch with the family and watched the neighbors' Christmas lights.

entries.title: I won the card game
entries.body: We had family game night. We played the matching card game where you flip two cards. I won! I remembered where all the octopus cards were. Dad said I have a super brain. Mom almost won but she flipped the wrong one. Lucas was on my team but he mostly chewed a card. Dad made popcorn and I found a popcorn that looked like a cloud.
entries.highlight: Played cards at family game night and won by matching the most pairs.

entries.title: Indoor recess and a paper airplane
entries.body: It was raining so we had indoor recess. That means no playground. We could do puzzles or blocks or draw. Me and Noah made paper airplanes. Mine flew all the way to the reading carpet. Noah's crashed into the turtle tank but not inside the turtle tank. Ms. Rivera said airplanes are for outside next time. We still had fun. I folded mine like a shark. Did you know some sharks can jump all the way out of the water? Mine did too.
entries.highlight: Had indoor recess because of rain and made a paper airplane that flew the farthest.

entries.title: A letter to Santa about Waffles
entries.body: I wrote a letter to Santa. Mom helped me spell some words. I asked for a puppy. I said his name will be Waffles and he will be brown and fluffy. I drew him at the bottom with a red bow. I also asked for a shark toy just in case. Mom said Santa does not usually bring puppies because the sleigh is too cold. I think Santa can figure it out.
entries.highlight: Wrote a letter to Santa asking for a puppy named Waffles and drew a picture of him.

entries.title: Class party before winter break
entries.body: Today was the last day of school before winter break. We got to wear pajamas to school! I wore my shark pajamas. I asked Ms. Rivera did you know sharks don't have any bones? She said she did not know that. It was raining so we stayed inside and watched a movie about a reindeer. Ms. Rivera gave everybody a candy cane and a pencil with snowflakes. Ruby brought cupcakes with green frosting. I said bye to everybody for like two weeks.
entries.highlight: Wore pajamas for the class party on the last day before winter break.

entries.title: Decorating Christmas cookies
entries.body: Tonight we decorated Christmas cookies. I made a snowman and a star and a tree. I put so many sprinkles on the snowman you could not even see him anymore. Mom said he is in a sprinkle blizzard. Lucas licked the frosting off his cookie and then asked for more frosting. Dad made one that looked like a shark with a Santa hat. That was the funniest one.
entries.favorite: The cookie with too many sprinkles
entries.highlight: Decorated Christmas cookies with the family and made a snowman cookie with lots of sprinkles.

entries.title: Lucas knocked down my tower
entries.body: Me and Lucas played blocks all morning. I built a tower almost as tall as me. And then Lucas ran over and knocked it down. Boom. I was so mad. I yelled Lucas! and he cried. Mom said he is only two and he thinks it is a game. Then Lucas gave me a block and said sorry Matty. So I built another one and let him knock it down on purpose.
entries.favorite: Building the tower almost to the ceiling
entries.highlight: Built a tall block tower that Lucas knocked over, and felt mad until Lucas said sorry.

entries.title: Tacos with extra cheese
entries.body: We had tacos for dinner. I like the crunchy shells, not the soft ones. I put meat and cheese and more cheese and no lettuce. My taco broke in half and all of it fell out. So I ate it with a fork like taco salad. Dad said that is a pro move. Did you know a great white can eat like a thousand pounds in one meal? That is a lot of tacos. I want tacos for every meal. Taco breakfast, taco lunch, taco dinner.
entries.highlight: Had tacos for dinner and wanted tacos every night of the week.

entries.title: A dog in a red sweater
entries.body: No school today so we went to the park in the morning. It was so cold. There was a little dog wearing a red sweater with a white snowflake on it. He was shaking even with the sweater. His name tag said Pickles. If Waffles gets cold I will make him a sweater too. Lucas tried to give the dog his mitten. That was nice of Lucas.
entries.highlight: Saw a little dog in a red sweater at the park during winter break.

entries.title: Paper snowflakes with Theo
entries.body: Theo came over after lunch. We made paper snowflakes with the scissors. You fold it and fold it and cut little triangles and then open it and it is a snowflake. Theo's looked like a spider web. Mine had a hole in the middle and looked like a jellyfish. We made like twenty and taped them all on the window. Now it looks like it is snowing inside. Mom said it is very festive.
entries.highlight: Made paper snowflakes with Theo and taped them all over the window.

entries.title: Christmas and a stuffed Waffles
entries.body: It was Christmas and it snowed! I woke up so early it was still dark. I got a stuffed puppy. He is brown and floppy. I named him Practice Waffles because he is practice for the real Waffles. Lucas got a toy truck and he drove it into everybody's feet. After presents we went sledding on the little hill. Then we had cinnamon rolls. Best Christmas ever.
entries.highlight: Got a stuffed puppy for Christmas, named it Practice Waffles, and went sledding in the snow.

entries.title: Christmas walk with reindeer dogs
entries.body: After Christmas dinner we went on a walk to see the snow and the lights. I brought Practice Waffles in my coat. There was a big dog wearing reindeer antlers on his head. He did not even care. He just sniffed the snow. Dad said that dog is having a merry Christmas. I said next Christmas Waffles will wear antlers too. Mom said we will see.
entries.highlight: Took a family walk on Christmas evening and saw a dog wearing reindeer antlers.

entries.title: Kai and the secret password
entries.body: Kai came over to play. We made a club in my room. You have to say the password to come in. The password is jellyfish pickle. Kai made it up and I laughed so hard. Lucas wanted to come in but he kept saying jelly pickle. So it did not count. Then Kai said okay that counts. Lucas came in and sat on the bed and just smiled.
entries.highlight: Had a playdate with Kai, made a secret password, and let Lucas in once he learned it.

entries.title: The aquarium with mom
entries.body: Mom and me went to the aquarium. Just us. There is a tunnel and the sharks swim right over your head. I saw a hammerhead and a sea turtle and a stingray. Did you know a sea turtle can hold its breath for hours? Mom did not know that. I could have stayed there like a hundred hours. But the big tank is so deep. I would never swim in that. I am scared of the deep end even at the pool. Mom said that is okay. I got a shark tooth necklace at the gift shop.
entries.highlight: Went to the aquarium with mom, loved the shark tunnel, and admitted deep water scares him.

entries.title: Walking Practice Waffles
entries.body: I asked mom for a puppy again. She said we will see. So I am practicing. I made a leash for Practice Waffles out of my jump rope. I walked him around the kitchen and the living room and up the stairs. I gave him a bowl of water but I did not put real water in it. Mom said real puppies need walks even when it is cold. I said I know. I can wear my big coat.
entries.favorite: Making a leash out of a jump rope
entries.highlight: Practiced taking care of a puppy by walking his stuffed dog around the house.

entries.title: Game night popcorn fight
entries.body: We had family game night. Dad made popcorn. We played the game with the ladders and the slides. I went down the biggest slide two times. Ugh. Lucas was on mom's team and he spun the spinner super hard. Dad threw popcorn and I caught it in my mouth three times. Mom said no popcorn throwing. Then she threw one at dad. I did not win but it was still really fun.
entries.highlight: Played a board game at family game night and practiced catching popcorn in his mouth.

entries.title: Lucas copies everything I do
entries.body: This morning Lucas copied everything I did. I brushed my teeth and he brushed his teeth. I put on my shoes and he put on his shoes but on the wrong feet. I made a silly face and he made a silly face. It was kind of annoying. But it was kind of funny too. Mom said he wants to be just like me. I said he can be like me but not today.
entries.highlight: Noticed little brother Lucas copying everything he did while getting ready for school.

entries.title: Rainy recess building with blocks
entries.body: It rained again so indoor recess again. Me and Noah built a swimming pool out of blocks. We put a little lifeguard chair. Then we made a deep end and a shallow end. I said the people only go in the shallow end. Noah said the deep end is the fun part. I don't think so. Ms. Rivera took a picture of our pool. It was the best block thing in the class.
entries.highlight: Had another rainy indoor recess and built a swimming pool out of blocks with Noah.

entries.title: Snow day sledding
entries.body: SNOW DAY! No school because of the snow. We went sledding on the big hill. My cheeks got so cold they were bright red. I went down on my tummy like a penguin. And then I hit a bump and flew off the sled into the snow. I was not hurt. I was laughing. Lucas went on the little hill with dad. We stayed until I could not feel my toes.
entries.favorite: Going down the big hill fast
entries.highlight: Had a snow day from school and went sledding until his cheeks got cold.

entries.title: The car wash with the big brushes
entries.body: After sledding dad said the car is so dirty from the snow and the salt. So we went to the car wash. You stay in the car and it moves by itself. The big blue brushes go whoosh on the windows. It is like being inside a giant dishwasher. Or inside a whale's mouth. Lucas covered his eyes. And then the soap is pink and blue. And then the dryer is so loud. I want to go again tomorrow.
entries.highlight: Rode through the car wash with dad to clean off the snow and salt.

entries.title: Kai's blanket cave has a door
entries.body: Kai came over to play. We built a cave out of blankets and the kitchen chairs. Kai made a door out of a towel. You have to knock but there is nothing to knock on so you say knock knock. Lucas wanted to come in. Kai said he can be the guard. So Lucas sat outside the door with his truck and guarded. He was a really good guard.
entries.favorite: The door made of a towel
entries.highlight: Built a blanket cave with a towel door with Kai and let Lucas be the guard.

entries.title: Snow angels with Kai
entries.body: Me and Kai went to the park and there was still snow everywhere. We made snow angels. Mine had the biggest wings, like a manta ray. Then we made a wall for a snow castle but it only got up to our knees. Kai threw a snowball and it hit the slide. And then I threw one and it hit Kai's hat. He laughed so I knew it was okay. We were so wet after.
entries.favorite: Making the snow angel with the biggest wings
entries.highlight: Made snow angels and a snow castle wall with Kai at the snowy park.

entries.title: The dog who ate snowballs
entries.body: There were so many dogs at the park today because of the snow. One big black dog was catching snowballs. His owner threw them and he jumped up and crunch! He ate them. He thinks they are treats. I made a snowball and his owner let me throw it. He caught it. If I had Waffles I would teach him to catch snowballs too.
entries.highlight: Watched a big dog at the snowy park catch and eat snowballs.

entries.title: Learning about penguins
entries.body: Today in school we learned about penguins. Penguins can't fly but they swim super fast. Some penguins slide on their bellies like me on my sled. Did you know the dad penguin keeps the egg warm on his feet? And then it rained so it was indoor recess again. We all waddled like penguins. Ms. Rivera was the mom penguin. Ruby knew like a hundred penguin facts.
entries.highlight: Learned penguin facts in class and waddled like a penguin during indoor recess.

entries.title: Noah and the Lego submarine
entries.body: Noah came over to play. We built a submarine out of Legos. It has a window and a claw and two little guys driving it. Did you know a real submarine can stay under the water for like a hundred days? And then Lucas wanted to come play. He wanted to hold the submarine and I said no because he breaks stuff. Noah said he can hold the little guy. So Lucas held the little guy and he was happy. Our submarine is on the shelf now. Nobody touch it.
entries.highlight: Built a Lego submarine with Noah during a playdate and kept it safe from Lucas.

entries.title: Dance party with Lucas
entries.body: Me and Lucas had a dance party in the living room after school. I put on the shark song. We did the shark dance with our arms. Then I made up a dance where you spin and fall down. Lucas loved it. He did it like a hundred times. He laughed so hard he got the hiccups. Okay he is kind of fun sometimes. Not when he knocks my towers down.
entries.highlight: Had a dance party with Lucas after school and made up a falling down dance.

entries.title: A puppy at the park
entries.body: There were so many dogs at the park today. But the best one was a tiny puppy. He was brown and fluffy just like Waffles would be. He chewed on my shoelace and would not let go. The lady said he is eleven weeks old. That is so little. I asked if he had a name and she said not yet. I almost said Waffles. But Waffles is my name for my puppy.
entries.highlight: Met a tiny puppy at the park that chewed on his shoelace.

entries.title: Hide and seek with Ruby
entries.body: Me and Ruby played hide and seek at the park. Ruby counted to twenty. I hid inside the tube slide. She looked everywhere. She looked behind the tree and under the bench. And then she heard me laughing. That is how she found me. When I was the seeker Ruby hid behind her mom. That is not fair but it was funny. Ruby knows a lot of facts about animals. She said owls can turn their heads almost all the way around. I said did you know an octopus can change colors to hide? That is the best hide and seek animal.
entries.highlight: Played hide and seek with Ruby at the park and found the best hiding spot in the tube slide.

entries.title: Ruby's animal hospital tent
entries.body: Ruby came over to play. We made a tent out of blankets and it was an animal hospital. Ruby was the doctor and I was the doctor too. We fixed all my stuffed animals. Practice Waffles had a broken leg so we put a sock on it. Lucas wanted to come in. He brought his teddy bear and said owie. So we fixed his bear with a bandaid. Ruby says she is going to be a real animal doctor.
entries.highlight: Turned a blanket tent into an animal hospital with Ruby and fixed all the stuffed animals.

entries.title: Noah and the hundred cup tower
entries.body: Today was the hundredth day of school! We brought a hundred things in a bag. I brought a hundred goldfish crackers. After school Noah came over and we made a tower out of a hundred paper cups. We counted every single one. It got really tall and then Noah sneezed and it fell down. We laughed so hard. A hundred is my favorite number. Now Lucas says like a hundred for everything, because of me. It is like a lot but not too much.
entries.highlight: Built a tower out of a hundred paper cups with Noah for the hundredth day of school.

entries.title: Cookie dough in a cup
entries.body: We went to the ice cream shop and I got cookie dough ice cream for the first time. Usually I get Shark Bite, the blue one with the gummy sharks. I found a cookie dough piece as big as a grape. I saved it for the last bite. Dad got coffee flavor. Yuck. Lucas fell asleep in his car seat so he did not get any. I felt a little bad. I said we should bring him a cup. Dad said that is very thoughtful.
entries.favorite: Finding the biggest cookie dough piece
entries.highlight: Got cookie dough ice cream with dad and found a giant piece of cookie dough.

entries.title: Waffles would sit on command
entries.body: I asked mom for a puppy again. She said we will see. I said I already know how to teach tricks. You say sit and you push his bottom down a little and then you give a treat. I showed her with Practice Waffles. He is very good at sitting because he is stuffed. Mom laughed. She said real puppies chew on everything. I said Lucas chews on everything too and we kept him.
entries.highlight: Asked for a puppy again and showed mom how he would teach it tricks.

entries.title: The ocean book at story time
entries.body: At story time Ms. Rivera read us a book about the ocean. Every page had a different animal. There was a page with a giant squid and its eye is as big as a dinner plate. I raised my hand and said sharks have like a hundred teeth and they grow new ones. Ms. Rivera said that is true! It is actually even more. Everybody said whoa. I want to read that book by myself.
entries.highlight: Listened to Ms. Rivera read an ocean book and shared shark facts with the class.

entries.title: Building a birdhouse with dad
entries.body: Dad and me built a birdhouse in the garage. Dad held the board still and I used the real hammer. I hit my thumb one time but only a little. We painted it blue like the ocean. I painted a little octopus on the side even though octopuses do not live in birdhouses. We hung it on the tree. No birds came yet. Dad said they need time to find it.
entries.highlight: Built a wooden birdhouse with dad and got to use a real hammer.

entries.title: Theo and the frozen puddle
entries.body: Me and Theo went to the park. It was freezing. There was a big puddle that turned into ice. We slid on it with our boots. Theo fell on his bottom and I fell on my bottom. Then we played red light green light by the swings. Theo's dad said we look like popsicles. Theo is my best friend. He likes sharks too but his favorite is the great white and mine is the hammerhead. Did you know a great white can smell one drop of blood from really far away? Theo told me that one.
entries.highlight: Played at the cold park with Theo and slid across a frozen puddle.

entries.title: A puppy valentine
entries.body: Tomorrow is Valentine's Day. I made valentines for everybody in my class. They have sharks and they say you are fin-tastic. Dad helped me with that word. And then I made one for mom with a puppy on it. It says will you be my valentine and can we get a puppy. Mom read it and laughed and said nice try buddy. That is not a no.
entries.highlight: Made a puppy-themed valentine for mom asking for a real puppy.

entries.title: My puppy poster for mom and dad
entries.body: I made a poster about why we should get a puppy. I wrote one, I will feed him. Two, I will walk him. Three, he will be a good friend for Lucas. Four, his name is already Waffles. I drew Waffles at the top. I showed it at dinner. Dad said wow that is a good poster. Mom said maybe we start with a smaller pet first. A smaller pet? I do not know what that means. But it sounded like almost yes.
entries.highlight: Made a poster with reasons to get a puppy and presented it to his parents at dinner.

entries.title: Taco Sunday
entries.body: We had tacos night but on a Sunday. Taco Sunday! I made my own taco. Meat and cheese and more cheese. Dad said try one tiny bit of salsa. I tried it and my mouth got hot and I drank all my milk. Dad laughed. Lucas only ate the shell part. Then he ate my shell part too. Next time I am getting two shells.
entries.highlight: Made his own tacos at a family taco night and tried a little bit of salsa.

entries.title: Flashlight cave with Noah
entries.body: Noah came over to play. We built a cave with the big brown blanket so it was really dark inside. Then we used flashlights and made shadow puppets on the wall. I made a shark with my hands. Noah made a bunny but it looked like a duck. Lucas wanted to come in and he was scared of the dark. So I gave him my flashlight. Then he was okay.
entries.highlight: Built a dark blanket cave with Noah and made flashlight shadow puppets.

entries.title: Ice cream with grandma
entries.body: Grandma took me and Lucas to the ice cream shop. Grandma said two scoops because it is a grandma day. I got Shark Bite on the bottom and chocolate on top. Lucas got one scoop and a cherry. Grandma got butter pecan. That is grandma ice cream. My scoops started to fall so I licked really fast. Grandma said I am a speedy licker. I had no tummy ache.
entries.favorite: Grandma letting me get two scoops
entries.highlight: Went for ice cream with grandma and she let him get two scoops.

entries.title: Drawing sea animals with Ruby
entries.body: Ruby came over to play. We drew sea animals with markers. I drew a hammerhead and a whale and a crab. Ruby drew an octopus with eight arms and she counted them. She said octopuses have three hearts. Three! I have only one. We taped them on the fridge. Lucas drew a circle and said it is a jellyfish. Okay Lucas, it can be a jellyfish.
entries.highlight: Had a playdate with Ruby where they drew sea animals and made up facts.

entries.title: Bath time with Lucas
entries.body: Tonight me and Lucas took a bath together. We made bubble beards. Lucas looked like grandpa in a picture. I made a bubble shark fin on my head. Did you know some sharks have to keep swimming or they can't breathe? So I kept moving my fin. And then Lucas splashed and got water on the floor. Mom said okay boys. I showed Lucas how to blow bubbles in the water. He tried but he got water in his nose. I said it is okay. I don't like water on my face either.
entries.highlight: Helped give Lucas a bath and made bubble beards together.

entries.title: Movie night with the clownfish movie
entries.body: We had movie night. We watched the movie with the little clownfish who gets lost. I have seen it like a hundred times but I still like it. The crab part is the funniest. Lucas got scared at the shark part and hid in the blanket. I told him the shark is nice at the end. We had popcorn and apple slices. I fell asleep before the end. That's okay because I know the end.
entries.highlight: Watched an ocean movie at family movie night and laughed at the crab.

entries.title: First warm day popsicles
entries.body: Today it was warm! Not summer warm but no coat warm. So mom said popsicles. I got orange. It was shaped like a shark fin. Lucas got red. We sat on the steps. My popsicle melted down my hand and down my arm. I licked my arm. Mom said gross. Lucas dropped his on the grass and cried so I gave him a bite of mine. Just one bite. It is a sharing rule.
entries.highlight: Had the first popsicle of the year on a surprisingly warm day.

entries.title: Dinner French toast with dad
entries.body: Dad said tonight is breakfast for dinner. We made French toast. I cracked an egg and only a little shell got in. Dad got it out. Then I dipped the bread in the egg and dad let me flip one. I flipped it and it landed back in the pan! A little bit on the side but still. Dad said that is a perfect flip. I put blueberries on mine in the shape of a whale. It looked like a whale this time. For real.
entries.favorite: Flipping the French toast by myself
entries.highlight: Made French toast for dinner with dad and flipped one on his own.

entries.title: Lucas turned three
entries.body: Today was Lucas's birthday. He is three now. He had a truck cake with yellow frosting. He tried to blow out the candles like a hundred times but he just spit. So I helped him. Not too hard, I let him do most. He got a dump truck and a ball. I gave him my old shark book. He hugged me. Then we played the game where you match the colors and Lucas won because we let him.
entries.highlight: Celebrated little brother Lucas's third birthday with a truck cake.

entries.title: What is a smaller pet
entries.body: I keep thinking about what mom said. A smaller pet. I asked her is it a goldfish? She said maybe. I asked is it a hamster? She said maybe. I asked is it a baby whale? She laughed and said definitely not. I still want Waffles. But a small pet could be practice. Like Practice Waffles but real. I told Practice Waffles not to worry. He is still number one.
entries.highlight: Tried to guess what smaller pet mom meant, guessing everything from a goldfish to a hamster.

entries.title: Ruby's new scooter
entries.body: Me and Ruby went to the park after school. Ruby got a new scooter and it is purple with lights in the wheels. She let me try it. I went down the little hill and I did not fall! Then she showed me how to go faster with your foot. We took turns like ten times. Ruby said the lights work even in the daytime. I want a scooter like that. A blue one with a shark on it.
entries.highlight: Took turns on Ruby's new scooter at the park after school.

entries.title: Ants on a log
entries.body: Mom showed me how to make ants on a log. You put peanut butter on celery and then raisins are the ants. I made the ants march all in a line. Lucas ate his ants first and then just licked the peanut butter. He gave me the celery. I don't really like celery but with peanut butter it is okay. I ate four logs. That's like forty ants.
entries.highlight: Made ants on a log with mom and turned the raisins into a marching line.

entries.title: Throwing the ball for a lab
entries.body: There were so many dogs at the park today. A yellow lab's owner let me throw the ball. I threw it far, really far. And then the dog ran so fast and brought it back all slobbery. I did it like twelve times. My arm got tired before the dog got tired. The owner said labs never get tired. Waffles would be a little dog so maybe he would get tired.
entries.favorite: The dog bringing the ball back
entries.highlight: Got to throw a ball for a friendly Labrador at the park.

entries.title: Noah and the race track
entries.body: Noah came over to play. We made a race track out of books and a big piece of cardboard. We raced my cars. The red one is the fastest. I call it the Mako, because the mako is the fastest shark. Noah's blue one flew off the edge and went under the couch. We had to use a ruler to get it out. There was also a sock and some old crackers under the couch. Gross. We raced until dinner.
entries.favorite: Our cars going off the edge
entries.highlight: Built a race track out of books with Noah and raced toy cars.

entries.title: Kai's jokes in the hideout
entries.body: Kai came over and we made a hideout in my room. Kai told me jokes in the hideout. Knock knock. Who's there? Banana. Banana who? He did banana like five times and then orange you glad I didn't say banana. I laughed so hard I fell on the hideout and it fell down. So we built it again. Then I told him my joke. What do sharks eat for lunch? Peanut butter and jellyfish. Kai laughed so hard he snorted. Kai is the funniest person in first grade.
entries.highlight: Built a hideout with Kai and traded jokes until they could not stop laughing.

entries.title: Sofia goes in the deep end
entries.body: Me and Sofia played at the park. Sofia can do cartwheels. She did like eight in a row. I tried and I just fell over sideways. Then Sofia said she is in swim lessons and she can go in the deep end. Without floaties! I still wear floaties at the pool. I did not tell her that. I said cool. Maybe I will do swim lessons too. But not in the deep part.
entries.highlight: Played with Sofia at the park and felt nervous hearing she swims in the deep end.

entries.title: Theo and the shark game
entries.body: Theo came over to play. We made up a game called shark attack. The floor is the ocean and the couch is the boat. If you touch the floor the shark gets you. Theo was the great white and I was the hammerhead. Did you know baby sharks are called pups? Like puppies! Lucas was a little minnow. He kept stepping on the floor on purpose so we could chase him. He screamed and laughed the whole time. It was so loud. Mom said inside voices, sharks.
entries.highlight: Made up a shark chasing game with Theo during a playdate.

entries.title: Ice cream after the dentist
entries.body: I went to the dentist today and I had no cavities. The dentist said my teeth are really clean. One tooth is a little bit wiggly! The dentist has a poster of a shark with all its teeth. I said did you know sharks never get cavities? She said she did not know that. So mom said we can get ice cream. That's funny because ice cream is bad for teeth. I got vanilla with rainbow sprinkles. I ate it on the side with no wiggly tooth. I wiggled it with my tongue the whole way home.
entries.highlight: Got ice cream as a treat after a good dentist checkup.

entries.title: Paper airplane contest with Kai
entries.body: Kai came over again. We made paper airplanes and had a contest in the backyard. Dad showed us how to fold the pointy kind. I drew teeth on mine so it was a shark plane. Kai made his wings really big. And then we threw them. Mine went to the swing set. And then Kai's went so high it flew over the fence into the neighbor's yard! We had to ring the doorbell to get it back. Lucas threw his plane at the ground. It still counts, I said. We made like twenty planes.
entries.favorite: My shark plane flying over the fence
entries.highlight: Had a paper airplane contest with Kai in the backyard after school, and his plane flew over the fence.

entries.title: Spaghetti noodle slurp
entries.body: We had spaghetti night. Dad makes the sauce with meatballs. I had a noodle that was as long as my arm. I slurped it and it hit my nose and made sauce on my face. Lucas tried to slurp and he did it! Then he did it again and again. Mom said this is a slurping family. I had two meatballs. And then three. I was so full.
entries.highlight: Had spaghetti for dinner and slurped the longest noodle at the table.

entries.title: Shark Bite with dad
entries.body: Dad took me for Shark Bite ice cream after school. That is the blue one with the gummy sharks. Two ice creams in one week! Dad said do not tell mom. Then he said just kidding, she knows. My wiggly tooth is so wiggly now. It moves back and front. I ate my ice cream really carefully. Dad said it might come out tonight. I don't know if I want it to come out or not. It is kind of scary and kind of cool. Did you know sharks lose teeth all the time and grow new ones? Like a thousand in their whole life. I only get one more set.
entries.favorite: Dad letting me hold the cone
entries.highlight: Shared Shark Bite ice cream with dad after he noticed the wiggly tooth getting looser.

entries.title: I lost my first tooth
entries.body: I LOST MY FIRST TOOTH! It came out when I was brushing my teeth. There was a little blood and I said mom mom mom! Mom came running. She said you are so brave. I was a little brave. We put my tooth in a little box under my pillow. Now I have a hole and I can whistle through it. Kind of. Lucas wanted to see it like a hundred times.
entries.favorite: The tooth in the little box
entries.highlight: Lost his first tooth at bedtime with mom and put it in a box for the tooth fairy.

entries.title: Showing Kai my missing tooth
entries.body: The tooth fairy came! She left a gold dollar coin and some glitter. Kai came over and I showed him the hole in my teeth. He said that is so cool. I told him my tooth fell out by itself, like a baby shark tooth. Kai has not lost any teeth yet. We played tooth fairy. I was the tooth fairy and Kai was the kid. I put a Lego under his pillow. He said that is not money. We played outside after because it was warm.
entries.highlight: Showed Kai his missing tooth and the gold dollar from the tooth fairy.

entries.title: Dogs playing in the mud
entries.body: There were so many dogs at the park after school. It rained so there was mud. One white dog rolled in it and he turned brown. His owner said oh no not again. I laughed so hard. Mom said that is why dogs are a lot of work. I said I would give Waffles a bath. In the bathtub with bubbles. Like Lucas.
entries.highlight: Saw dogs playing in the mud at the park and laughed at a white dog that turned brown.

entries.title: I read a book to the class
entries.body: It was raining so we had indoor recess again. But this time something cool happened. Ms. Rivera said who wants to read a book to the class? I raised my hand. I read the ocean book with the giant squid. The whole thing! I only got stuck on two words. Octopus and enormous. Ms. Rivera helped me. Everybody clapped at the end. It sounded like a hundred people clapping. I felt so proud my face got hot.
entries.highlight: Read a whole picture book out loud to his class during a rainy indoor day.

entries.title: April Fools ice cream
entries.body: Today was April Fools Day. Dad gave me a bowl of ice cream after dinner. I took a big bite and it was mashed potatoes! With a cherry on top! Dad said April Fools! I was so surprised. Then he gave me real ice cream. Strawberry. I tricked Lucas by saying there is a whale in the yard. He ran to the window. April Fools, Lucas.
entries.highlight: Got tricked on April Fools by dad, who served mashed potatoes that looked like ice cream.

entries.title: Mom has a pet secret
entries.body: I asked mom for a puppy again. She did not say we will see this time. She said we will talk about it soon. And then she smiled at dad and they whispered. I think they have a secret. I asked Lucas if he knows the secret. He said yes. Then he said the secret is a cookie. Lucas does not know anything. I can't wait.
entries.highlight: Noticed mom and dad whispering about a pet surprise and hoped it was a puppy.

entries.title: A tent outside
entries.body: Kai came over and it was sunny so we built a tent outside. We put a sheet over the picnic table. It was like a real camping tent. We brought snacks inside. Goldfish and apple juice. Kai said this is our camping trip. I said no, it is a submarine and we are at the bottom of the ocean. A bird came and sat in my birdhouse! The first bird ever! I yelled and it flew away. Oops. It will come back.
entries.highlight: Built the first outdoor tent of spring with Kai under the backyard tree.

entries.title: Practicing for a real pet
entries.body: I asked mom again about the pet secret. She said if we got a pet, what jobs would you do? So I made a list. Food every morning. Water every day. Play with it. Clean up. And if it is a puppy, walks. I already have the name. Waffles. Mom said that is a good list but jobs are every day, even when you are tired. I said I know. Even when I am tired. Even when I am playing. I really really promise.
entries.highlight: Asked again about a pet and practiced by making a chart of jobs for taking care of one.

entries.title: Ruby and the roly-polies
entries.body: Me and Ruby played at the park after school. We found roly-polies under a rock. Ruby said they are not really bugs, they are more like a shrimp. A shrimp! On land! Did you know a shrimp has its heart in its head? I saw that at the aquarium. We found nine of them. One rolled into a ball in my hand. It tickled. We put them back under the rock so they could go home. Ruby knows everything about animals.
entries.highlight: Looked for roly-poly bugs at the park with Ruby, who knew lots of bug facts.

entries.title: Chalk ocean with Noah
entries.body: Noah came over to play. We drew on the driveway with chalk. I drew the whole ocean. A whale and a shark and a jellyfish. Did you know jellyfish don't have a brain? Not even a little one. Noah drew a boat. Then Lucas came and drew a big green scribble. I said Lucas that's not a sea animal. He said it is seaweed. Okay that is actually right. Then we jumped from whale to whale. Don't fall in the water!
entries.highlight: Drew a giant chalk ocean on the driveway with Noah.

entries.title: Pumping up my bike tires
entries.body: Dad and me got my bike out of the garage. The tires were squishy like a pool float with no air. Dad showed me how to use the pump. You push down and push down and push down. It is hard work. My arms got tired. Then the tire was hard again. I rode around the driveway with my training wheels. Dad said maybe this summer the training wheels come off. Maybe.
entries.highlight: Got his bike out of the garage for spring and helped dad pump up the tires.

entries.title: Egg hunt at recess
entries.body: At recess we had an egg hunt on the playground! Ms. Rivera hid plastic eggs everywhere. I found six. I wanted like a hundred. One was under the slide and one was in the tire swing. And then I found the golden egg! It was behind the fence post. Inside it was a shark sticker and a coupon for extra computer time. Theo found five. I gave him one of mine so we were tied.
entries.highlight: Found the golden egg at a recess egg hunt at school.

entries.title: Sofia teaches me cartwheels
entries.body: Me and Sofia went to the park after school. Sofia said she would teach me cartwheels. You put your hands down and kick your legs over. I did it like twenty times. Most of them I fell. But the last one my legs went up kind of high. Sofia said that one counts. Lucas tried one too and it was just a somersault. Sofia is good at teaching. She did not laugh when I fell. Okay she laughed one time but I laughed too.
entries.highlight: Practiced cartwheels at the park while Sofia coached him.

entries.title: Laser came home
entries.body: WE GOT A KITTEN! This is the smaller pet! It was Easter and after the egg hunt mom and dad said get in the car. We went to the shelter and there she was. She is tiny and gray and her eyes are green. She sleeps a lot. When she woke up she ran across the room so fast like a laser. So I named her Laser. Lucas wanted to name her Kitty. Laser is better. It is the best day ever.
entries.highlight: Brought home a tiny gray kitten on Easter and named her Laser because she runs so fast.

entries.title: My jobs for Laser
entries.body: Tonight mom said here are your Laser jobs. One is breakfast food. Two is fresh water. Three is playing with her so she is not bored. Dad does the litter box. Good. I gave Laser her water and she sniffed it and walked away. Then she sat on my foot and fell asleep. I could not move for a long time. I did not want to wake her up. I am a cat brother now.
entries.highlight: Learned his new jobs taking care of Laser on her first night home.

entries.title: Teaching Lucas gentle hands
entries.body: Lucas wanted to hold Laser so bad. But he squeezes too hard. So I showed him gentle hands. You use one finger and go soft like a feather. Lucas did it and Laser did not run away. She even closed her eyes. Lucas whispered she likes me. I said yes because you were gentle. Mom said I am a good teacher. I felt like a big brother.
entries.highlight: Taught Lucas to pet Laser gently with one finger.

entries.title: Laser crashes game night
entries.body: We had family game night. We played the matching card game again. I was winning. And then Laser jumped on the table! She sat right on the cards and swished her tail and the cards went everywhere. Nobody won. Dad said Laser wins. Laser got a game piece and batted it under the couch. Then she fell asleep in the box from the game.
entries.highlight: Played cards at family game night until Laser jumped on the table and scattered them.

entries.title: Picking a toy for Laser
entries.body: Mom and me went to the pet store. Just us again. We got food for Laser and I got to pick a toy. There were like a hundred toys. I picked a feather on a stick. And then I saw the puppy stuff. Little leashes and little bowls. I touched a puppy collar that was blue. Mom said one pet at a time. At home Laser jumped so high for the feather.
entries.highlight: Went to the pet store with mom and picked out a feather wand toy for Laser.

entries.title: First sprinkler day
entries.body: It was so warm today that dad got out the sprinkler. The water was SO cold. I screamed when it hit me. And then I ran through it again. Lucas just stood next to it and let it hit his tummy. He laughed every time. Laser watched from the window. She does not like water. Me neither when it is deep. But sprinkler water is fine.
entries.highlight: Ran through the sprinkler for the first time this year on a warm day.

entries.title: Ruby meets Laser
entries.body: Ruby came over to meet Laser. Ruby was so gentle. She knew that cats like when you scratch under their chin. Then she said cats sleep like sixteen hours a day. That is why Laser sleeps so much! We built a blanket cave and Laser came in the cave. She sat in the middle like the queen. Ruby said Laser is a very good name for a cat. I said I know.
entries.highlight: Built a blanket cave with Ruby, who met Laser and shared cat facts.

entries.title: Making sundaes at home
entries.body: Mom bought ice cream and toppings so we made sundaes at home. I put chocolate sauce and whipped cream and a cherry and gummy worms. Gummy worms on ice cream! Dad said that is wild. Lucas put so much whipped cream his bowl was all white. Laser wanted to lick the whipped cream. Mom said no, not for kitties. I ate the whole thing and had no tummy ache.
entries.highlight: Made ice cream sundaes at home with the whole family.

entries.title: My seventh birthday pool party
entries.body: It was my birthday! I am seven now. I had a pool party at the indoor pool at the rec center. Theo and Kai and Sofia and Noah and Ruby all came. I wore my floaties and stayed in the shallow part. Sofia jumped in the deep end. I didn't. Then the cake was shaped like a dog! It was brown and fluffy like Waffles. When everybody sang Lucas sang the loudest. Seven is a good number.
entries.highlight: Turned seven and had an indoor pool party with a dog-shaped cake.

entries.title: Dad's present was goggles
entries.body: After the party dad gave me one more present. It was goggles with sharks on the side! And a paper that said swim lessons. I got a little nervous. Dad said you will start in the little pool and the teacher will help you. And you don't have to go in the deep end until you are ready. I said what if I am never ready. Dad said you will be.
entries.highlight: Received shark goggles from dad and learned he would start swim lessons soon.

entries.title: I forgot Laser's breakfast
entries.body: This morning I forgot to give Laser her breakfast. I was playing with my new goggles. Mom did it. After school she said Laser was crying by her bowl. I felt really bad. That is my job. I gave Laser extra pets and I said sorry Laser. She bumped her head on my hand. Mom said everybody forgets sometimes but jobs are important. Tomorrow I will remember.
entries.highlight: Forgot to feed Laser before school and felt bad when mom had to do it.

entries.title: Frisbee with dad
entries.body: Me and dad played frisbee at the park. At first I could not throw it. It just went into the ground. Dad said flick your wrist like this. Then mine went straight! Kind of straight. Then dad threw it and I caught it with ONE hand. Dad yelled whoa! A dog tried to get our frisbee. I said that is not your frisbee, buddy. He was a nice dog though. He was a fluffy Pomeranian, like the one I want. When I get mine I am going to name him Waffles.
entries.highlight: Played frisbee at the park with dad and caught it with one hand.

entries.title: Making our own popsicles
entries.body: Mom helped me and Lucas make our own popsicles. We poured apple juice and grape juice in the shark molds from the aquarium gift shop. And then we put them in the freezer. We had to wait like a hundred hours. Actually it was after dinner. Lucas checked the freezer like ten times. They came out like little juice sharks. They were so good. Mine was grape and Lucas's was apple and grape mixed. It looked kind of brown but it tasted good.
entries.highlight: Made homemade juice popsicles with Lucas and waited all day for them to freeze.

entries.title: Laser naps in the sunshine
entries.body: After school Laser was sleeping in the sunny spot on the carpet. She was all curled up like a cinnamon roll. Then her paws were twitching. Mom said she is dreaming. I think she is dreaming about the feather toy. Or a bird. I laid down next to her very quietly. The sun was warm. I almost fell asleep too. I did not forget her breakfast this week.
entries.highlight: Watched Laser take a nap in a sunny spot and wondered what she dreams about.

entries.title: Crabbing with dad
entries.body: Dad and me went crabbing at the bay after school. We sat on the dock. I stayed in the middle of the dock because the water was dark. Dad tied a chicken leg on my string for bait. Yuck. I did not catch anything. But I saw a little crab pinch the chicken! Dad said that is a good start. We threw rocks in the water after. I made a big splash. On the way home I said did you know crabs can grow back a claw? Dad said I'm a walking ocean book.
entries.highlight: Went crabbing at the bay with dad and watched a small crab pinch the bait.

entries.title: My first swim lesson
entries.body: Today was my first swim lesson. It was at the indoor pool. My teacher is Miss Marina. She is really nice and she has a whistle. I was nervous. My tummy felt funny. We stayed on the steps first. Then she showed us how to blow bubbles. I put my face in! With my shark goggles! I saw everybody's feet underwater. It was so weird and so cool.
entries.highlight: Had his first swim lesson, felt nervous, and learned to blow bubbles underwater.

entries.title: Memorial Day cookout
entries.body: No school today because it is a holiday. We went to grandma's for a cookout. Dad grilled hot dogs and burgers. I had a hot dog with ketchup only. Grandma cut watermelon in triangles. I had a seed spitting contest with dad. My seed went so far. Lucas swallowed his seed and got worried. Grandma said no watermelon will grow in your tummy. Lucas was relieved.
entries.highlight: Had a holiday cookout with burgers and watermelon at grandma's house.

entries.title: Laser and Waffles could be friends
entries.body: I love Laser so much. But I still want a puppy. I asked mom if Laser would be lonely without a dog. Mom said cats are okay alone. I said but what if she wants a friend. Laser and Waffles could sleep together. Mom said let's see how you do with Laser first. So I have to be really good at Laser jobs. Then maybe Waffles.
entries.highlight: Loves Laser but still asked about a puppy, imagining Laser and Waffles as friends.

entries.title: The pool opened
entries.body: The outdoor pool is open! It was hot. I wore my floaties and my shark goggles. I stayed in the shallow end where my feet can touch. Lucas was in the baby pool so I went in there with him for a while. Then I looked at the deep end. Big kids were jumping off the diving board. Splash! I am not doing that. Not this summer. Maybe never.
entries.favorite: Splashing with Lucas in the baby pool
entries.highlight: Went to the outdoor pool on opening weekend, wore floaties, and stayed in the shallow end.

entries.title: Last day of first grade
entries.body: Last day of school! No more first grade! We all wore white shirts and signed each other's shirts with markers. Theo wrote shark boy on mine. Ruby drew a cat because of Laser. Ms. Rivera hugged everybody. I got a little sad. She was a good teacher. She said keep reading! Now it is pool time all summer. And swim lessons. Second grade is next. That is so big.
entries.highlight: Finished first grade, signed shirts with friends, and said goodbye to Ms. Rivera.

entries.title: First summer day at the park
entries.body: Me and Ruby went to the park for the first summer day. We saw a little snake in the grass! It was green with yellow stripes. I jumped back. Ruby said it is a garter snake and they are not dangerous. She knows everything. We watched it go into the bushes. Then I said, did you know there are sea snakes in the ocean that can hold their breath for hours? Ruby did not know that one. I finally knew a fact she did not know. Then we swung on the swings and tried to touch the sky with our feet.
entries.highlight: Spent the first summer Saturday at the park with Ruby, who spotted a garter snake.

entries.title: Popsicle drips on the porch
entries.body: It was hot so we had popsicles on the porch. I got the kind with two sticks. I broke it in half and gave one half to Lucas. He said thank you Matty. It melted down my arm so fast. I had to lick it from the bottom. A bee came and I froze like red light green light. It went away. Then the popsicle was just a stick. I told Lucas, did you know an octopus has three hearts? He said, popsicles have zero hearts. That is true.
entries.highlight: Shared a double popsicle with Lucas on the porch on a hot day.

entries.title: Backyard water fight with dad
entries.body: After dinner we had a backyard water fight. Me and Lucas against dad. We had water balloons and squirt guns. I got dad right in the back! Splat! He yelled and chased me. Lucas could not throw far so he just dropped balloons on dad's shoes. Dad sprayed us with the hose. We were all soaking wet. Mom watched from the porch and she stayed dry.
entries.favorite: Getting dad right in the back
entries.highlight: Had a water balloon fight in the backyard and soaked dad.

entries.title: Ruby's backyard tent
entries.body: I went to Ruby's house to play. We built a tent in her backyard with sheets and clothespins on the fence. It was like a little house. Ruby brought mango slices. I never had mango before. It is so sweet and slippery. We pretended we were explorers on an island, and the grass was the ocean and it had sharks in it. We had to find food. The food was more mango.
entries.highlight: Built a tent with Ruby in her backyard out of sheets and clothespins.

entries.title: I floated on my back
entries.body: At swim lessons Miss Marina taught us to float on our backs. She held my back at first. She said put your tummy up to the sky. And then she let go! And I was still floating! By myself! I could see the ceiling lights. I was a little scared but I stayed still and it worked. Miss Marina gave me a high five. When I told mom she did a happy dance.
entries.highlight: Floated on his back by himself at swim lessons and felt very proud.

entries.title: Kicking with a noodle
entries.body: At swim lessons we kicked with a noodle. You hold the noodle under your arms and kick kick kick. I went all the way across the little pool. Then Miss Marina said try with your face in. I did it with my goggles. I saw a band-aid on the bottom. Gross. My legs are tired now. Miss Marina says strong kicks are the secret.
entries.highlight: Practiced kicking across the pool with a pool noodle at swim lessons.

entries.title: Snack picnic in the living room
entries.body: It rained today so me and Lucas had a snack picnic on the living room floor. Mom put a blanket down. We had cheese crackers and grapes and pretzels. Lucas made a grape tower. I made a pretzel shark. Laser tried to steal a cracker. She did not like it. She sneezed. That was so funny. We watched a show about dolphins while we ate. Did you know dolphins sleep with half of their brain? The other half stays awake. Lucas said he does that too. He does not.
entries.highlight: Had a snack picnic on the living room floor with Lucas on a rainy day.

entries.title: A dog in a life jacket
entries.body: We went to the park by the lake. There was a dog wearing a life jacket! It was orange. He jumped right in the water and swam. His owner said he is still learning to swim. Like me! I learn to swim with floaties and he learns with a life jacket. I bet Waffles would like to swim. Laser would not like to swim. No way.
entries.highlight: Saw a dog in a life jacket at the lake park and talked about swimming.

entries.title: Teaching Lucas frisbee
entries.body: After the dogs we played frisbee. I tried to teach Lucas how to throw. I said flick your wrist like this, like dad told me. Lucas threw it backwards over his head. It hit dad. Everyone laughed. Then he tried again and it went one foot. I said good job anyway. He is three. Dad said I am being patient. I am being so patient.
entries.highlight: Tried to teach Lucas how to throw a frisbee at the park.

entries.title: Laser caught the mouse
entries.body: Laser is a hunter. I threw her toy mouse across the kitchen. She got low and wiggled her bottom. And then she pounced! She caught it. Then she carried it in her mouth and dropped it on my foot. Mom said that is a present for you. A present! I said thank you Laser. Then I threw it again. We did that like twenty times.
entries.highlight: Watched Laser stalk and catch her toy mouse, then bring it to him.

entries.title: Laser's favorite box
entries.body: Mom got a new cat bed for Laser. It was soft and fluffy and it came in a box. Laser did not even look at the bed. She jumped in the box! She sat in it all day. She popped her head out when I walked by. Peek a boo. Dad said cats love boxes more than anything. I drew windows on the box. Now it is Laser's house.
entries.favorite: Laser popping out of the box
entries.highlight: Laughed when Laser chose the empty delivery box over her new cat bed.

entries.title: Burgers and fries night
entries.body: We had hamburgers and french fries for dinner. Dad made the burgers on the grill. I had cheese on mine. And then dad said try this. He dipped a fry in his chocolate milkshake. I said yuck. Then I tried it. It was so good! Salty and sweet. Lucas tried it and he made a weird face. More for me. I had no tummy ache.
entries.highlight: Had burgers and fries for dinner and tried dipping a fry in a milkshake.

entries.title: No floaties in the shallow end
entries.body: At the pool today I took my floaties off! Only in the shallow end. Dad stood like four steps away and said swim to me. I put my face in and kicked like Miss Marina said. And then I touched dad! He moved back more and I did it again. Then I stood up and I was so happy I jumped. I still wore floaties after that. But I did it.
entries.highlight: Took off his floaties for the first time and swam to dad in the shallow end.

entries.title: Laser and the sock
entries.body: Laser is so silly. She stole one of my socks out of the laundry basket. It was a shark sock. And then she ran around the whole house with it in her mouth. Up the stairs and down the stairs. Lucas chased her. I chased Lucas. Mom said who has my sock? I said Laser! We found it under my bed later with like three other socks.
entries.favorite: Laser running away with the sock
entries.highlight: Laughed as Laser stole a sock out of the laundry and raced around the house with it.

entries.title: Catching fireflies with Lucas
entries.body: After dinner me and Lucas caught fireflies in the backyard. It was getting dark and they were blinking everywhere. I caught one in my hands and I showed Lucas. It blinked inside my hands. Lucas said it is a tiny flashlight. Then I helped him catch one. He held it so careful. Gentle hands, like with Laser. Then we let them all go.
entries.highlight: Caught fireflies in the backyard with Lucas and helped him hold one.

entries.title: Theo sleeps over in the submarine
entries.body: Theo slept over again! It is summer so we stayed up late. We built the blanket submarine again in the living room and dad let us watch a shark movie in the submarine. It was a little scary but not too much. Laser came in the submarine and slept on Theo's sleeping bag. Theo said she likes me! We talked about second grade. Theo hopes we are in the same class.
entries.favorite: Watching the shark movie in the submarine
entries.highlight: Had Theo sleep over again and watched a shark movie inside a blanket submarine.

entries.title: Rocket pops before fireworks
entries.body: Tonight we went to the summer festival in the park. They had a truck that sold ice cream. I got a rocket pop. It is red and white and blue and it looks like a rocket. The blue part is the best. Lucas got an ice cream sandwich and the cookie part got soggy. We watched a band play and I danced with mom. Tomorrow is the Fourth of July and there will be fireworks. I am going to cover my ears because they are so loud, but I still want to watch them.
entries.favorite: The red, white and blue popsicle
entries.highlight: Had rocket pops and ice cream at a summer festival the night before the Fourth.

entries.title: Fireworks on Ruby's blanket
entries.body: For the Fourth of July we watched fireworks with Ruby's family at the field by the school. We put our blankets next to each other. Ruby brought glow sticks and we made them into bracelets and necklaces. When the fireworks started I covered my ears because they boom in your chest. But I still looked. There was a gold one that came down slow like a jellyfish. Ruby said fireworks are just chemistry. I said they are also magic. Lucas fell asleep on dad before the big ending.
entries.highlight: Watched Fourth of July fireworks with Ruby's family and covered his ears for the loud ones.

entries.title: Building a sand castle with Lucas
entries.body: Me and Lucas played in the sandbox all morning. I wanted to build a giant castle with towers. Lucas wanted to dig. At first I was annoyed because he kept digging under my towers. And then I had an idea. I said Lucas, you are the moat digger. Dig all the way around. He dug so hard. He was so serious. Then we filled the moat with the watering can. It worked! The castle had water all around like a real one. Teamwork, mom said.
entries.highlight: Built a sandbox castle with Lucas and gave him the job of digging the moat.

entries.title: Water fight with Kai and Theo
entries.body: Kai and Theo came over for a water fight in the backyard. We filled up like fifty water balloons. Okay, mom filled a lot of them. Me and Kai were a team and Theo was by himself but he had the big squirt gun. I hid behind the slide and waited. And then when Theo came around I got him with two balloons at the same time. Kai made up a battle cry that was just yelling pickles. We were all so wet our shoes squished. Laser watched from the window like water was the worst thing in the world.
entries.highlight: Had a huge backyard water fight with Kai and Theo and hid behind the slide to ambush them.

entries.title: Water park vacation
entries.body: We went on vacation to a water park! We stayed in a hotel and the water park was right there. There was a wave pool. Every ten minutes a horn goes off and big waves come. I wore a life jacket and jumped over the waves with dad. It was like the real ocean. Did you know the biggest real waves are like a hundred feet tall? These were not that big. Then the lazy river and the twisty tube slide. I rode almost everything. Except the really steep slide. It is like straight down. I watched dad go down it and he screamed. Maybe next time. Maybe.
entries.highlight: Went on vacation to a water park and rode almost everything, but skipped the steepest slide.

entries.title: I cooked the noodles on vacation
entries.body: Our hotel room had a little kitchen. Dad said tonight you are in charge of the noodles. I measured the water and dad turned on the stove. Then I put the noodles in really careful so I would not splash. I set the timer for ten minutes by myself. I stirred so they would not stick. When the timer beeped dad helped me pour them out because the steam is hot. Mom said these are the best noodles ever. Lucas ate his with just butter. I was really proud.
entries.highlight: Made spaghetti dinner with dad in the vacation kitchen and was in charge of the noodles.

entries.title: Laser's water bowl was empty
entries.body: We came home from vacation and Laser was so happy. Grandma took care of her while we were gone. But this morning I forgot to fill her water. I was telling Theo about the water park on the tablet. Then I saw Laser on the bathroom counter licking the faucet. Mom said she was thirsty. I felt my face get hot. I filled her bowl all the way up and said sorry like a hundred times. I need a way to remember. My brain forgets when I am excited.
entries.favorite: Laser drinking out of the faucet
entries.highlight: Came home from vacation, forgot to refill Laser's water, and felt guilty when she drank from the sink.

entries.title: Telling Sofia about the wave pool
entries.body: Me and Sofia played at the park. I told her about the wave pool and the lazy river. She said did you go down the steep one? I said no. I thought she would laugh. But she said she was scared of that one too the first time. Then she said wave pools are scary and I did it, so I am brave. Then we played lava monster on the playground. Sofia was the monster. She growls really good.
entries.highlight: Told Sofia all about the water park at the park, and she said he was brave.

entries.title: Swimming where I can't touch
entries.body: At swim lessons Miss Marina took us to the part where your feet do not touch. I said no thank you. She said I will be right next to you. So I tried. I swam from the wall to her. It was only like five big kicks. When I could not feel the bottom my tummy went whoosh. But I kept kicking. Then I held the wall. Miss Marina said you did it without floaties! I did it again two more times. My heart was beating so fast.
entries.highlight: Swam in deeper water at lessons, where his feet could not touch, with Miss Marina close by.

entries.title: Picking blueberries with mom
entries.body: Mom and me went blueberry picking at the farm. Just us. We each had a bucket. The best berries are dark blue and they fall off when you touch them. The red ones are not ready. I ate like one for every three I picked. Mom ate some too so she can't say anything. My fingers turned purple. On the way home mom let me pick the music again. Then we made blueberry waffles for Lucas and dad.
entries.highlight: Went blueberry picking with mom and ate almost as many as he picked.

entries.title: Laser sleeps in the laundry
entries.body: Laser is the sleepiest cat in the world. Mom took the towels out of the dryer and put them in the basket. Then she went to get a drink. When she came back Laser was in the basket asleep in the warm towels. Mom said I guess these are Laser's towels now. Laser opened one eye and closed it again. I put my hand in the basket and it was so warm. I understand Laser. Warm towels are the best.
entries.highlight: Found Laser asleep in a basket of warm, clean laundry.

entries.title: Washing the car in the driveway
entries.body: Me and dad washed the car in the driveway. Dad had a bucket with soap and two big sponges. I did the doors and dad did the top. The car got so foamy it looked like a cloud. Then I got the hose. I sprayed the roof and the windows and then dad by accident. Okay maybe a little on purpose. He sprayed me back. Lucas did the tires with a little brush. The car was so shiny. Dad gave me a dollar for working.
entries.favorite: Spraying the hose on the roof
entries.highlight: Washed the car with dad in the driveway and sprayed the roof with the hose.

entries.title: Theo and the Lego aquarium
entries.body: Theo came over and we made a Lego aquarium. It had a tunnel like the real aquarium and a shark tank. We each made a shark. Mine was a hammerhead and his was a great white. Then we argued about which shark is better. I said did you know hammerheads can see all around? Theo said did you know great whites are bigger? We said they can both be the best. Lucas brought a duck and wanted to put it in the tank. Theo said ducks are allowed. So now there is a duck in our aquarium.
entries.highlight: Built a Lego aquarium with Theo and argued about which shark was the best.

entries.title: A little brown dog named Biscuit
entries.body: At the park after dinner there was a little brown dog named Biscuit. She did a spin when her owner said spin. And she gave me a high five! Her paw was so soft. Biscuit looked like how I think Waffles would look. Fluffy and small. I told mom see, little dogs are easy. Mom said that dog is two years old and had lots of practice. I said Laser has practice too. Maybe I can teach Laser a trick.
entries.highlight: Met a small brown dog at the park that did tricks, and thought about Waffles.

entries.title: The sprinkler limbo game
entries.body: It was so hot today, like a hundred degrees. Actually ninety-four. Dad put the sprinkler on the kind that goes back and forth. Me and Lucas made up sprinkler limbo. You have to go under the water when it comes over you. If you get wet you lose. But we always got wet. So we both lost every time and laughed. Laser watched from the window again with her tail going back and forth like the sprinkler.
entries.highlight: Invented a sprinkler limbo game with Lucas on a hot afternoon.

entries.title: I swam in the deep end
entries.body: I swam in the deep end! No floaties! At the big pool dad said do you want to try? My tummy said no but my brain said yes. Dad got in the deep end and stayed next to me. I pushed off the wall and kicked and pulled like Miss Marina taught me. It was so deep and blue under me. And then I touched the other wall! I did it! Dad hugged me and we both went under a little. Mom was cheering so loud. Last summer I would not even look at the deep end.
entries.highlight: Swam all the way across the deep end of the pool without floaties for the first time.

entries.title: I taught Laser a trick
entries.body: After the pool I wanted to do another brave thing. So I tried to teach Laser a trick like Biscuit. I held a treat up high and said high five. Laser just looked at me. I tried like twenty times. Then she reached up with her paw to get the treat and touched my hand! I gave her the treat right away. Then we did it again and she did it again! Mom said I was so patient. Two big things today. This is maybe the best day ever.
entries.favorite: Laser giving me a high five
entries.highlight: Taught Laser to give a high five for a treat after many tries.

entries.title: Telling Ruby about the deep end
entries.body: Me and Ruby went to the park. I told her I swam in the deep end. She said that is so good. She said people float better in salty water like the ocean. So someday when I swim in the ocean it will be easier. Then we played on the zip line. Ruby went super fast and her hair flew everywhere. When it was my turn I went so fast I almost fell off at the end but I held on.
entries.highlight: Told Ruby he swam in the deep end, and she shared a fact about how people float.

entries.title: No more training wheels
entries.body: Dad took the training wheels off my bike! We went to the big flat part at the park. Dad held the back of my seat and ran with me. I said don't let go don't let go. And then I looked back and dad was standing way back there. He let go and I was riding by myself! I got scared and fell in the grass. But it did not hurt. I got back on and did it again. Dad said a summer of brave things.
entries.highlight: Rode his bike without training wheels for the first time at the park.

entries.title: Riding bikes with Noah
entries.body: Noah came to the park with his bike. I showed him I can ride with no training wheels now. He said I learned last year. Oh. But then he said you are really good for just one day. We rode around the loop like five times. We raced to the bench and Noah won, but only a little. I fell one time on the gravel and scraped my knee. I did not cry. I just said ow really loud. Bikes are done. Next is the diving board.
entries.highlight: Rode bikes at the park with Noah the day after learning to ride without training wheels.

entries.title: I read all the game cards
entries.body: We had family game night. We played a new game with question cards. I read every card out loud by myself. Even the long words. Lucas was on my team so I let him roll the dice. Dad said who taught you to read like that? I said Ms. Rivera and me. Then mom won the game and I lost. Usually I get grumpy when I lose. But this time I said nice job mom, you won fair and square. Mom looked so surprised. She said you are growing up. I felt kind of tall.
entries.highlight: Read all the cards himself during family game night and stayed calm when he lost.

entries.title: Getting ready for second grade
entries.body: Tomorrow is the first day of second grade. Dad took me to get a haircut. The lady used the buzzer on the back and it tickled. Then we came home and I packed my backpack. It is new and it has a hammerhead on it. Did you know a hammerhead's head has a real name? It is cephalofoil. I can't say it right yet. I packed my pencils and my folder and my water bottle. I put my shark tooth necklace in the small pocket for good luck. I am excited but my tummy is a little bit wobbly too.
entries.highlight: Got a haircut with dad and packed his new backpack the night before second grade.

entries.title: First day of second grade
entries.body: First day of second grade! Theo is in my class again! We high fived so hard it hurt. My teacher is Mr. Okafor. He is tall and he has a bow tie with sharks on it. Sharks! I knew he would be a good teacher. I was a little nervous at first because I did not know where to put my lunch. But Mr. Okafor showed me. Ruby is in the class next door. We waved at recess. Second grade is going to be good.
entries.highlight: Started second grade with Mr. Okafor and was happy Theo was in his class again.

entries.title: Frisbee with Laser's audience
entries.body: After the first week of school dad and me played frisbee in the backyard. I can throw it straight now almost every time. Dad threw one really high and I ran and caught it right before the fence. Then I threw one and dad dove for it and landed in the grass. He had a green stain on his shirt. Mom said really? Laser was in the window watching the frisbee go back and forth like it was a bird.
entries.highlight: Played frisbee in the backyard with dad while Laser watched from the window.

entries.title: The last water fight of summer
entries.body: It is the last weekend of summer so we had one more big water fight. This time mom played too! Me and mom were a team against dad and Lucas. Lucas has a little squirt gun that only goes a little bit. I let him get me so he could feel good. Then mom got dad with a whole bucket. Dad said I give up! We were all laughing. Mom's hair was dripping. She said that is the most fun she had all summer.
entries.highlight: Had an end-of-summer water fight where even mom joined in and got soaked.

entries.title: Laser waits for me after school
entries.body: Mom said Laser sleeps all day when I am at school. She has like five sleeping spots. The sunny carpet, my bed, the box, the laundry basket and the top of the couch. But when I come home she wakes up and comes to the door. Mom said she knows when the bus comes. She yawned so big today I saw all her little teeth. I think she missed me. I missed her too.
entries.highlight: Noticed that Laser sleeps all day but wakes up when he comes home from school.

entries.title: Laser versus the moth
entries.body: A moth got in the house tonight. It was flying by the lamp. Laser saw it and her eyes got so big and black. She wiggled her bottom and then jumped so high she almost touched the lamp. She missed. The moth flew to the curtains. Laser climbed the curtains! Mom said no no Laser. Dad caught the moth in a cup and put it outside. Laser looked at the window for like an hour after.
entries.highlight: Watched Laser chase a moth around the living room at night.

entries.title: The new card game from grandma
entries.body: Grandma gave us a new card game. You match the colors or the numbers and there are wild cards. We played it at family game night. I had one card left and I said the word you have to say. Then I put down a wild card and I won! Lucas played with dad and he just put down any card he wanted. Nobody minded. Dad made kettle corn which is sweet and salty popcorn. I ate a lot of it.
entries.highlight: Played a new card game grandma gave them and won with a wild card at the end.

entries.title: Riding my bike to the park
entries.body: After school I rode my bike to the park! Mom walked behind with Lucas in the wagon. I had to stop at every corner and wait. That is the rule. I rode over the little wooden bridge and it went bumpity bump. At the park I rode around the loop and then played on the climbing net. On the way back I was tired but I still rode the whole way. Mom said I am getting so strong.
entries.highlight: Rode his bike to the park after school for the first time, with mom walking behind.

entries.title: Lucas and the first fallen leaves
